Cycling uses ORS general cycling, not a: Cycling uses the OpenRouteService general cycling profile, not a gravel-specific profile. Hiking uses foot-hiking. Routes depend on mapped roads and trails; check access and conditions before setting out. Moving time and terrain elevations are estimates. Missing elevation is shown as unavailable, not zero. Round trips are calculated by the provider and may differ from your target distance.
(ODbL). Default OSM tiles are for low-tr: (ODbL). Default OSM tiles are for low-traffic development; use a suitable hosted provider for production. No map tiles are downloaded for offline use. Routing & place search ©
The proxy forwards the places you search: Search queries and route points are sent to OpenRouteService through the app’s server. Your saved library is not uploaded; provider keys stay on the server. In a production build, saved routes and GPX can be used offline after the app has been cached. Map tiles are not stored offline. Loading map tiles, searching places and calculating routes depend on an internet connection and their providers.
